description: Checkov scans cloud infrastructure configurations to find misconfigurations before they're deployed
name: checkov

options.description: Show help for checkov
name: --help
-h

options.description: Show the version of checkov
name: --version
-v

options.description: CLI output, display only failed checks
options.name: --quiet

options.description: CLI output, do not display code blocks
options.name: --compact

options.description: List checks
name: --list
-l

options.description: Do not fetch Bridgecrew platform IDs and guidelines for the checkov output report. Note: this prevents Bridgecrew platform check IDs from being used anywhere in the CLI
options.name: --no-guide

options.description: Print Bridgecrew platform IDs (BC...) instead of Checkov IDs (CKV...), if the check exists in the platform
options.name: --output-bc-ids

options.description: IaC root directory (can not be used together with --file)
name: --directory
-d

options.description: Report output format. Add multiple outputs by using the flag multiple times (-o sarif -o cli)
name: --output
-o

options.description: IaC frameworks to include checks for
options.name: --framework

options.description: IaC frameworks to exclude checks for
options.name: --skip-framework

options.description: Generate a new check via CLI prompt
options.name: --add-check

options.description: IaC file(can not be used together with --directory)
name: --file
-f

options.description: Path (file or directory) to skip, using regular expression logic, relative to current working directory. Word boundaries are not implicit; i.e., specifying 'dir1' will skip any directory or subdirectory named 'dir1'. Ignored with -f. Can be specified multiple times
options.name: --skip-path

options.description: Filter scan to run only on a specific check identifier (allowlist). You can specify multiple checks separated by comma delimiter. You may also use the environment variable: CKV_CHECK
name: --check
-c

options.description: Filter scan to run all check except a specific check identifier (denylist). You can specify multiple checks separated by comma delimiter. You may also use the environment variable: CKV_SKIP_CHECK
options.name: --skip-check

options.description: Run all external checks (loaded via --external-checks options) even if the checks are not present in the --check list. This allows you to always ensure that new checks present in the external source are used. If an external check is included in --skip-check, it will still be skipped
options.name: --run-all-external-checks

options.description: Directory for custom checks to be loaded. Can be repeated
options.name: --external-checks-dir

options.description: Bridgecrew API key. You may also use the environment variable: BC_API_KEY
options.name: --bc-api-key

options.description: Scan docker images by name or ID. Only works with --bc-api-key flag
options.name: --docker-image

options.description: Path to the Dockerfile of the scanned docker image
options.name: --dockerfile-path

options.description: Identity string of the repository, with form <repo_owner>/<repo_name>
options.name: --repo-id

options.description: Selected branch of the persisted repository. Only has effect when using the --bc-api-key flag
name: --branch
-b

options.description: Do not download fixed resource templates from Bridgecrew. Only has an effect when using the --bc-api-key flag
options.name: --skip-fixes

options.description: Do not download preconfigured suppressions from the Bridgecrew platform. Code comment suppressions will still be honored. Only has an effect when using the --bc-api-key flag
options.name: --skip-suppressions

options.description: Do not download custom policies configured in the Bridgecrew platform. Only has an effect when using the --bc-api-key flag
options.name: --skip-policy-download

options.description: Download external terraform modules from public git repositories and terraform registry. You may also use the environment variable: DOWNLOAD_EXTERNAL_MODULES]
options.name: --download-external-modules

options.description: Variable files to load in addition to the default files (see https://www.terraform.io/docs/language/values/variables.html#variable-definitions-tfvars-files). Currently only supported for source Terraform (.tf file), and Helm chart scans. Requires using --directory, NOT --file
options.name: --var-file

options.description: Set the path for the download external terraform modules. You may also use the environment variable: EXTERNAL_MODULES_DIR
options.name: --external-modules-download-path

options.description: Evaluate the values of variables and locals
options.name: --evaluate-variables

options.description: Custom CA (bundle) fila. You may also use the environment variablee: CA_CERTIFICATE
name: --ca-certificate
-ca

options.description: Directory containing the hcl code used to generate a given plan file. Use with -f FILE
options.name: --repo-root-for-plan-enrichment

options.description: Path to the Checkov configuration YAML file
options.name: --config-file

options.description: Takes the current command line args and writes them out to a config file at the given path
options.name: --create-config

options.description: Prints all arguments and config settings and where they came from (eg. commandline, config file, environment variable or default)
options.name: --show-config

options.description: Save all current results to a '.checkov.baseline' file so future runs will only flag new findings. Works only with `--directory` flag
options.name: --create-baseline

options.description: Use a '.checkov.baseline' file to compare current results with a known baseline. Report will include only failed checks that are newwith respect to the provided baseline. See --create-baseline
options.name: --baseline

options.description: Runs checks but suppresses the error code
name: --soft-fail
-s

options.description: Exits with a 0 exit code for specified checks. You can specify multiple checks separated by comma delimiter
options.name: --soft-fail-on

options.description: Exits with a non-zero exit code for specified checks. You can specify multiple checks separated by comma delimiter
options.name: --hard-fail-on

options.description: Set minimum severity to return a non-zero exit code
options.name: --min-cve-severity

options.description: Ignore specific open source package when SCA scanning for CVEs in package dependencies. Can be used multiple times to skip multiple packages
options.name: --skip-cve-package

options.description: Use the Enforcement rules configured in the platform for hard / soft fail logic
options.name: --use-enforcement-rules

options.description: Enable debug logs and upload the logs to the server
options.name: --support

options.description: Chose whether the summary will be appended on top or on bottom
options.name: --summary-position

options.description: Exclude extra resources (resources without violations)
options.name: --skip-resources-without-violations

options.description: Do not download any data from Prisma Cloud
options.name: --skip-download

options.description: Maximum time to run the history scan
options.name: --secrets-history-timeout

options.description: Will scan the history of commits for secrets
options.name: --scan-secrets-history

options.description: The Prisma Cloud API URL
options.name: --prisma-api-url

options.description: Comma separated key:value string to filter policies based on Prisma Cloud policy metadata
options.name: --policy-metadata-filter

options.description: Name of the output folder to save the chosen output formats
options.name: --output-file-path

options.description: Output checks that are skipped due to baseline file presence
options.name: --output-baseline-as-skipped

options.description: Add an OpenAI API key to enhance finding guidelines. This will send Code to OpenAI
options.name: --openai-api-key

options.description: Return exit code 0 instead of 2
options.name: --no-fail-on-crash

options.description: Each entry in the list will be used for masking the desired attribute
options.name: --mask

options.description: When running with an API key, Checkov will omit any policies that do not exist in the Bridgecrew or Prisma Cloud platform
options.name: --include-all-checkov-policies

options.description: GitHub URL of external checks to be added
options.name: --external-checks-git

options.description: Enable secret scan for all files
options.name: --enable-secret-scan-all-files

options.description: Enable combine TF graph and TF Plan graph
options.name: --deep-analysis

options.description: List of files to filter out from the secret scanner
options.name: --block-list-secret-scan
